potentials.name: Basic Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Basic Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Common Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Common Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: +30% Damage Amount to Slash cards, and adds the following effect: increase Damage Amount of Exhaust cards by 15% for 1 turn (max 2 stacks).

potentials.name: Unique Card Upgrade
potentials.text: Increase Damage, Shield, and Healing Amounts of Unique Cards by 2/20%.

potentials.name: Basic Card Proficiency
potentials.text: +5% Damage Amount to Nine's Slash, and if Nine's Defense is greater than 250, add an additional +5% to the modifier.

potentials.name: Unique Stat Upgrade
potentials.text: If Nine's Defense is greater than 300, +5% Order Attribute Damage Amount, and for every 10 Defense exceeding 300, add an additional +2% to the modifier (up to an additional +10%).

manifestEgo.name: Awakening Memory
manifestEgo.text: At the start of battle create 1 Exploit Opening card. Exploit Opening: 1 Vulnerable, 1 Tenacity Damage.

manifestEgo.name: Vivid Memory
manifestEgo.text: +150 Damage Amount to Reflection: Zero, and +50% Damage Amount to the modifier for the combined Cost of the 2 highest-Cost cards effect.

manifestEgo.name: Inner Memory
manifestEgo.text:

manifestEgo.name: Complete Memory
manifestEgo.text: Increase the level of [Basic Card Upgrade], [Unique Card Upgrade], and [Common Card Upgrade] in Potentials by 3.
